card.name: Digits inside multi-digit dose numbers
card.fires_on: A digit, usually the 0 or a middle digit, inside a multi-digit dose number such as 140, 200, 500 or 1,400. It comes right before the unit mg in dose tables and dose-reduction schedules.

modes.label: Final zero in dose tables
modes.description: The trailing 0 of a three-digit dose in a dose-reduction or weight-band table, just before mg.
modes.example: First dose reduction 20<<0>> mg daily (five 40 mg

modes.label: Middle digit of a range or comma number
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a larger number, in a dose range or a number with a comma.
modes.example: 750 to 12<<5>>0 mg/day for adults given in divided
